title: calluna vulgaris var. hirsuta
intro: Calluna vulgaris var. hirsuta, commonly known as hairy heather, is a variety of the calluna vulgaris plant species, characterized by its hairy leaves and stems. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of hairy heather include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic actions, which make it useful for treating various skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of hairy heather include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
